work_unit: fictional golden dataset v0 and deterministic local evaluator

evidence.uncertainty: The existing synthetic evaluator needed a reviewed fictional-document contract without presenting OCR output as ground truth.
evidence.scope: The data contract, six deterministic metrics, test-only evaluator, regression tests, and privacy documentation must agree.
evidence.reasoning: The implementation distinguishes direct lookups, retrieval ranking, citation support, unavailable answers, and out-of-scope guidance.
evidence.verification: The work needs schema validation and focused tests for each metric without live provider or Langfuse access.

dispatch.mode: delegated dataset authoring plus coordinator integration

outcome.implementation: A 10-case local dataset uses only supplied fictional samples. The evaluator accepts an explicit test-only result envelope and reports Evidence Recall@3, Evidence Recall@5, MRR, citation support rate, abstention accuracy, and direct-path accuracy.
checks: backend: uv run pytest -q tests/test_fictional_gold_eval.py tests/test_source_grounding_eval.py
backend: uv run ruff check scripts/fictional_gold_eval.py tests/test_fictional_gold_eval.py --no-cache
backend: uv run ruff format --check scripts/fictional_gold_eval.py tests/test_fictional_gold_eval.py
observed_limitations: No provider, application API, or Langfuse call is made by the local evaluator.
A live fictional-sample adapter and a Langfuse experiment require separate review and configured Langfuse credentials.
The data is a Q&A and grounding regression baseline, not an OCR accuracy benchmark.
